Table theme registry

Source: vignettes/articles/table-themes.Rmd
table-themes.Rmd
On this page

sdvplotR ships one table theme for each of 122 surveyed sources, named after the source: datagolf, basketball-reference, wikipedia, nejm. The same registry is read by sdvplot (Python) and sdvtables (JavaScript), so a name means the same table in every language. The list below is built from sdv_table_themes() when this article is knit, so it cannot drift from the package.

The full gallery, with filters, is at https://plot.sportsdataverse.org/guides/table-theme-registry.

gt_object |> gt_theme_source("datagolf")             # a gt table
gt_object |> gt_theme_source("datagolf", mode = "dark")
reactable::reactable(df, theme = reactable_sdv_theme("datagolf"))

Both functions read the registry only. The 27 reactablefmtr names (such as espn) raise an error pointing at the reactablefmtr:: function; the registry’s espn-site is the site’s own look. mode = "dark" works for themes whose dark policy is native (measured) or derived (from the light palette); on a none theme it raises, naming three dark-capable themes in the same category.
